notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Image on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Mirror Image do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Mirror Image.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Mirror Image.
Activate Mirror Image by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Mirror Image ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
